name: suede-co-marketing
description: Suede AI co-marketing discipline: partner fit scored on audience overlap and reciprocity, joint offers and campaign formats (content, webinars, integrations, community), operating roles, lead-sharing and consent terms, shared measurement, and joint content built to earn links and AI citations for both brands. Use when identifying potential partners or planning a specific joint campaign or cross-promotion. NOT FOR: affiliate or customer-referral programs (use suede-referrals), product-launch orch
author: JasonColapietro
